test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Foundational Full Test - 04
subject: general
question:
**Directions:** In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts, read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

**I.** Some jams are donkeys.

**II.** No donkey is a bread.

**Conclusions:**

**I.** Some donkeys are not jams.

**II.** No bread is a donkey.
solution:
The least possible Venn Diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/761db69dfff948d90f1deb18390b585899d5158dc90d70708771b81b9cb62838.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some donkeys are not jams – False (Some donkeys are jams but we don't know about the remaining part of donkeys).

II. No bread is a donkey – True (It is true as no donkey is a bread).

Hence, **Only conclusion (II) follows.**
